name: Richmond upon Thames Local Plan ‘The best for our borough’ (2024 to 2039)

housing-numbers.notes: Plan has total requirement of 5,928 dwellings over 2024-2039 period. London Plan sets 10-year target of 4,110 homes (2019-2029) at 411 per annum, which is rolled forward. Small sites windfall target is 234 per annum (2,340 over 10 years from 2019-2029). Stepped trajectory: 210 per annum 2021-2025, 420 per annum 2025-2028, 670 per annum 2028-2031.
